00046 DiskInUGenInternal::DiskInUGenInternal(File const& file, const int numChannels, bool loopFlag, const double startTime, const int numFrames) throw()
00047 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(0, numChannels - 1),
00048     file_(file),
00049     loopFlag_(loopFlag),
00050     startTime_(startTime)
00051 {   
00052     bufferData = new float*[numChannels];
00053     
00054     filePlayer.addChangeListener(this);
00055     filePlayer.setFile(file, numFrames);
00056     filePlayer.prepareToPlay(UGen::getEstimatedBlockSize(), UGen::getSampleRate());
00057     
00058     filePlayer.setPosition(startTime);
00059     filePlayer.start();
00060 }
00061 
00062 DiskInUGenInternal::~DiskInUGenInternal() throw()
00063 {
00064     filePlayer.releaseResources();
00065     filePlayer.removeChangeListener(this);
00066     
00067     delete [] bufferData;
00068 }

00071 void DiskInUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00072 {
00073     int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00074     int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00075     for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
00076     {
00077         bufferData[i] = proxies[i]->getSampleData();
00078     }
00079     
00080     AudioSampleBuffer audioSampleBuffer(bufferData, numChannels, blockSize);
00081     
00082     AudioSourceChannelInfo info;
00083     info.buffer         = &audioSampleBuffer;
00084     info.numSamples     = blockSize;
00085     info.startSample    = 0;
00086     
00087     if(filePlayer.isPlaying())
00088         filePlayer.getNextAudioBlock(info);
00089     else
00090         info.clearActiveBufferRegion();
00091 }
00092 
00093 void DiskInUGenInternal::changeListenerCallback (void*)
00094 {
00095     if(filePlayer.isPlaying() == false && loopFlag_ == true)
00096     {
00097         filePlayer.setPosition(startTime_);
00098         filePlayer.start();
00099     }
00100

00116 void DiskIn::initWithJuceFile(File const& file, bool loopFlag, const double startTime, const int numFrames) throw()
00117 {
00118     AudioFormatManager formatManager;
00119     formatManager.registerBasicFormats();
00120     
00121     AudioFormatReader* reader = formatManager.createReaderFor (file);
00122     int numChannels = reader->numChannels;
00123     delete reader;
00124     
00125     initInternal(numChannels);
00126     generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternal(file, numChannels, loopFlag, startTime, numFrames));  
00127 }
